asset_heavy.reason: Owns hot-mix asphalt plants, aggregate quarries, liquid asphalt terminals and paving equipment fleets needing ongoing capital investment.

big_ticket.reason: Highway, runway and site paving projects are large, infrequent contracts for public agencies and developers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Mostly public road, highway and airport work funded by state and federal agencies, plus maintenance; relatively resilient in downturns.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are state and federal agencies, municipalities, airports and military installations, plus private developers.

notes: Public company known as a Sunbelt asphalt paving contractor; services are the larger part, with asphalt and aggregate sales secondary.

offers_products.reason: Sells hot-mix asphalt and aggregates to external customers, though mostly used in its own projects.

offers_services.reason: Core business is constructing, paving, milling, repairing and maintaining roads, highways, runways and commercial sites.

people_delivered.reason: Paving relies on plants, materials and heavy equipment, not mainly staff time and skill.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue comes from project-based contracts for road, airport and site work, though maintenance work repeats.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are government agencies and private developers or commercial owners, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: State and federal agencies, municipalities, school districts, military, developers and commercial property owners buy its paving work.
